headline: Cook moves 19 House races toward Democrats, none toward Republicans
detail: Six seats went from Toss Up to Lean D (AZ-06, CO-08, NC-11, TX-34, VA-02, WI-03) and KY-06 and TX-35 became toss-ups. Cook now projects a Democratic gain of 12 to 22 seats.

headline: Raters shift South Carolina, Nebraska and Texas toward toss-up
detail: RealClearPolitics moved SC and NE to Toss Up and GA to Likely Dem on Oct 25; Inside Elections moved Texas to Toss-up on Oct 23. Cook still rates SC Lean R and NE Likely R.

headline: Final Maine and Alaska debates turn personal
detail: Collins and Jackson sparred after a protester interrupted; Sullivan and Peltola clashed over the Iran war and energy prices.

headline: More than 30 million ballots already cast
detail: Texas passed 4 million in its first week of early voting, which ends Oct 30. Turnout counts show who is voting, not how.
source: UF Election Lab via TNND, ABC13

headline: Texas stays within the margin of error
detail: A University of Houston poll (Oct 10–14) has Talarico 48, Paxton 46. Trump is scheduled in Nueces and Lubbock counties today.

headline: Generic ballot leads range from D +5 to D +11
detail: NYT/Siena and YouGov show Democrats up 11, Echelon Insights up 5. Polls overstated Democrats in some recent cycles.

headline: Obama to Atlanta Wednesday; Trump back to Iowa Sunday
detail: Obama was scheduled to campaign with El-Sayed in Detroit on Oct 24 and joins Ossoff on Oct 28. Trump returns to Iowa for Hinson on Nov 1.

headline: Polling averages move toward Democrats in five Senate races
detail: RealClearPolitics now has Peltola +1.2 in Alaska, El-Sayed +2.5 in Michigan, Talarico +1.8 in Texas and Flanagan +5.1 in Minnesota, and Graham’s South Carolina lead is down to 2.4. RCP now rates Minnesota Leans Democratic; Cook moved it from Likely D to Lean D on Oct 20.

headline: PBS/NPR/Marist poll has Democrats up 8 among likely voters
detail: Likely voters back Democrats 52–44 on the generic ballot (Oct 19–20); 40% approve of Trump’s job performance and 59% disapprove. About one in five likely voters said they had already voted.

headline: Nearly 33 million ballots cast
detail: The University of Florida Election Lab count reached nearly 33 million by Tuesday afternoon, about half by mail and half in person. Turnout counts show who is voting, not how.

headline: Trump and Talarico both rally in Lubbock
detail: Trump campaigned with Paxton in Lubbock on Tuesday; Talarico stopped in Midland and Amarillo before his own Lubbock rally that evening.

headline: Obama rallies in Atlanta today
detail: Obama joins Ossoff and gubernatorial nominee Keisha Lance Bottoms at a “United for Georgia” rally, 4–7 p.m. Eastern.

headline: New York Times/Siena poll: South Carolina tied
detail: Graham and Andrews are at 48% each. Cook rates it Lean R; RealClearPolitics calls it a toss-up.

headline: Alaska fight over a second Dan Sullivan on the ballot
detail: The New York Times reported Democratic operatives discussed recruiting Daniel J. Sullivan Jr., whose name resembles the senator’s. Trump said Peltola should be removed from the ballot; her campaign says it had no involvement.
source: Fox News (Oct 28), citing the New York Times

headline: Hamilton edges ahead in Kansas average; El-Sayed’s Michigan lead grows
detail: RealClearPolitics now has Hamilton +0.2, El-Sayed +3.2, Talarico +2.2 and Jackson +1.4. Brown’s Ohio average slipped to +2.6, though a new Suffolk poll has him up 47–44.

headline: Detroit News poll has El-Sayed up 6
detail: Glengariff’s survey of 600 likely voters (Oct 19–22) has El-Sayed 51, Rogers 45.

headline: Nearly 40 million early votes
detail: NBC News counts more than 39.6 million mail and in-person early votes as of this morning. Turnout counts show who is voting, not how.

headline: Trump rallies for Husted; Speaker Johnson stumps for Merrin
detail: Trump held his third Ohio rally this month in Chillicothe on Wednesday. Johnson campaigned in Lucas County for Derek Merrin’s rematch with Marcy Kaptur.

headline: CNN polls: Democrats ahead in Kansas, Maine, Texas and Michigan
detail: Among likely voters (Oct 20–27): Hamilton 49–45, Jackson 49–45, Talarico 49–43, El-Sayed 49–42. Kansas and Maine are within the margin of error.

headline: Inside Elections shifts nine Senate races toward Democrats
detail: Ohio and Texas move to Tilt D; Iowa and Kansas to Toss-up; Nebraska and South Carolina to Tilt R; Georgia to Likely D; Louisiana and Mississippi to Likely R.

headline: Justice Department widens its Alaska lawsuit
detail: DOJ, which sued Oct 22 to block certification if Sullivan loses and votes for the second Sullivan could have decided it, filed an amended complaint. Alaska’s election officials, Peltola and the DSCC are asking the judge to dismiss it.

headline: Nearly 44 million early votes
detail: NBC News counts more than 43.9 million mail and in-person early votes as of this morning, up about 4 million in a day. Turnout counts show who is voting, not how.
